headline: Confirmed starting goalie is the largest single pre-match input. Median within-team starter-vs-backup gap is 0.36 GSAx/60 against a 6.03 goals/game baseline = 4-7% win probability, more than any skater input. Treat an unconfirmed goalie as a hard gate.

open_questions: European confirmed starting goalies are UNSOLVED. No aggregator verified, untestable in the July offseason. Given that starter identity is the headline input, European pre-match models are structurally weaker than NHL ones until this is revisited in September.
All European endpoints are league-site backends, not contractual APIs. Pin fixtures; they can change without notice.
key_findings: Rest is measured, not folklore: 0 days rest = 43.6% win rate, 1 day = 54.2%.
Empty-net goals are 6.7% of all goals and almost all land in P3 - strip them for strength estimation, add back for totals and margin.
BTTS baseline is 90.2%, so the real bet is 'will either be shut out'.
Never quarter the 60-minute total for period markets: the split is P1 28.7 / P2 33.1 / P3 35.7.
PDO is not a predictor, it is the regression flag: above 102 over fewer than 30 games is a fade.
Goal-based form is mostly PDO noise - use xG-based form windows.
